description: Find repair businesses near a location in France, Czechia, Slovakia, Austria or Germany (OpenStreetMap + ADEME data). Give either a barcode (ean, the product's repair category is looked up) or a repair_type, plus either lat+lon (rounded to ~1 km before use, never stored) or postcode+country. Returns up to 10 repairers with distance, address, website, opening hours and the source/licence line for each. repair_type is one of: phone_tablet, computer, tv_audio, appliance_large, appliance_small, electronics, photo, tools_garden, bike, e_mobility, shoes_leather, clothing, furniture, watch_jewellery, lighting, toys, sport, music, general.

country.description: FR, CZ, SK, AT or DE (with postcode).
country.title: Country

postcode.description: Postcode, used with country instead of lat/lon.
postcode.title: Postcode

repair_type.description: Repair category, e.g. phone_tablet, bike, appliance_large.
repair_type.title: Repair Type

name: repair_nearby
